advanced.diagnostics: Adds OSC Log and Inspector tabs to the main tab bar.
app.offline_toggle: Mode hors ligne : ignore tous les messages OSC entrants et sortants. Permet de modifier les données du spectacle sans affecter la console. Repassez en ligne pour reprendre.
conn_mode.disabled: Disconnect to change the connection mode.
conn_mode.mode1: Mode 1: GP OSC only — the open protocol, no iPad.
conn_mode.mode2: Mode 2: direct iPad protocol — the daemon talks to the console as an iPad.
conn_mode.mode3: Mode 3: iPad proxy — the daemon sits between a real iPad and the console.
cue.add: Add a new cue to the list from the fields above.
cue.console_row: Console snapshot row to recall on the desk (iPad-protocol modes).
cue.list_jump: Jump to this cue and recall it.
cue.name: Optional name for the cue.
cue.number: Cue number — orders the cue list (e.g. 1, 2.5).
cue.save_changes: Save the edits to the selected cue.
cue.skip: Passer — avancer au cue suivant sans le rappeler.
cue.undo: Annuler le dernier rappel de cue / snapshot.
gang.absolute: Absolute mode: moving a member sets the others to the same value.
gang.balance_width: Stereo balance (-1 to +1) and width — applies to stereo input channels only (GP OSC, input-only per the S21 chart).
gang.cancel_edit: Cancel editing and clear the form.
gang.cg_membership: Control Group membership — which CGs the channel belongs to. Settable via the iPad protocol only (Mode 2 / Mode 3) using CGs_level / CGs_mute bitmasks; GP OSC has no CG-membership writer. Only propagates between same-type members.
gang.channel_type: Channel type for the gang's members.
gang.dyn1: Dynamics 1 — compressor / gate parameters and on/off.
gang.dyn2: Dynamics 2 — second processor parameters and on/off.
gang.edit: Load this gang into the editor below to change its members or linked sections.
gang.enable_toggle: Enable or disable this gang. While off, moving a member doesn't propagate to the others.
gang.eq: Parametric EQ — band gains, Q, freq, dynamic-EQ settings, EQ on/off.
gang.fader_mute_pan: Channel fader level, mute and pan/balance.
gang.graphic_eq: Graphic EQ band gains. Only meaningful when ganging Graphic EQ channels (GEQ1, GEQ2, …).
gang.group_routing: Group routing — which group buses the channel feeds. Only propagates between same-type members.
gang.input_gain: Head-amp gain, total/computed gain, gain tracking, phantom power, main/alt input switch, stereo mode (input channels only).
gang.inserts: Insert A / B send / return enable.
gang.matrix_sends: Matrix-send levels and on/off. Only meaningful when ganging Matrix Input channels (MI1, MI2, …).
gang.name: Channel name string.
gang.needs_enable: Enable the gang first to change its mode or pause it.
gang.new_members: Channels to include — range notation like 1-4,7,12 (or I1-4,A1-2,G5 for mixed types).
gang.pause: Temporarily suspend propagation without unlinking — members keep their grouping; moves stop mirroring until you resume.
gang.polarity: Phase / polarity invert. Available on input, aux, group and matrix channels.
gang.relative: Relative mode: moving a member shifts the others by the same delta, preserving their offsets.
gang.save: Create the gang from the fields above — saves edits when editing an existing gang.
gang.sends: Aux send levels and on/off across all aux buses. Only propagates between members of the same channel type.
gang.trim: Channel trim level (-40 dB to +40 dB). Available on input, aux, group and matrix channels.
inspector.filter: Filter rows whose channel, parameter, or value contains this text.
inspector.sort_header: Click to sort by this column; click again to reverse.
inspector.type_all: Show parameters for every channel type.
inspector.type_filter: Show only parameters for this channel type.
macro.add_step_commit: Append a new step to the macro from the fields on this row.
macro.add_step_kind: Choose what this step does — write a parameter, drive a cue / connection, run another macro, recall a snapshot or palette, or send a QLab command.
macro.add_swatch: Add the current color to your saved swatches (per show)
macro.create: Create a new empty macro with the name on the left.
macro.dedup_selected: For every selected step, drop other steps with the same (channel, parameter)
macro.keep_only_step: Keep only this step for its (channel, parameter); remove the rest
macro.learn_discard: Stop recording and discard the captured steps.
macro.learn_needs_conn: Connect to the console first — Learn captures inbound parameter changes.
macro.learn_ready: Record every parameter change made on the console into a new macro.
macro.learn_stop_save: Stop recording and save the captured steps as a new macro.
macro.mirror_inbound: Mirror the most-recent inbound parameter from the console into the form below so you can hit Add Step without retyping.
macro.palette_channel_number: Channel number to apply the recalled palette to.
macro.palette_channel_type: Channel type to apply the recalled palette to.
macro.qlab_cue_number: QLab cue number — free-form string (numbers, letters, dots). Sent as `/cue/<number>/start`.
macro.rename: Rename this macro — edits apply immediately to the list and any Stream Deck labels.
macro.reset_step_delay: Reset this step's delay to 0 ms
macro.run: Run the selected macro now — fires its steps in order.
macro.step_delay: Delay in milliseconds before this step fires during playback.
macro.step_mode: How the value is applied: Toggle flips on/off, Fixed sets an absolute value, Relative adds an offset to the live value.
macro.step_select_hint: Click to select; Ctrl/Cmd-click to toggle; Shift-click to range-select.
macro.step_value: Value written by this step — an absolute value in Fixed mode, an offset in Relative mode.
macro.target_macro: Macro this step runs when fired.
macro.target_palette: Palette this step recalls when fired.
macro.target_snapshot: Snapshot this step recalls when fired.
macro.track_dirty: Treat this macro's parameters as modified — its writes mark the affected parameters dirty so auto-update can capture them into snapshots.
macro.wizard_channel_number: Channel number this parameter step targets.
macro.wizard_channel_type: Channel type this parameter step targets.
macro.wizard_parameter: Specific parameter within the chosen section that this step writes.
macro.wizard_section: Processing section (fader, EQ, dynamics, sends, …) the parameter lives in.
macro.zero_delay_selected: Set delay to 0 ms on every selected step
monitor.add_profile: Create a monitoring profile — choose which auxes and inputs a musician's monitor app may control.
monitor.edit_profile: Edit this profile's name and permitted channels.
monitor.picker_cancel: Discard changes and close without saving the profile.
monitor.picker_save: Save this monitoring profile and close.
monitor.profile_pin: Optional PIN for the web (browser) login. Leave it blank for name-only login; the native monitor app ignores it.
monitor.reorder: Rearrange this profile's channel order — drag the badges, then click Done.
monitor.reorder_done: Finish reordering and save the new channel order.
monitor.ripple: Range-select inputs: click the first, then the last, to select everything between them.
monitor.ripple_confirm: Select every input between the two you picked.
osc_log.filter: Show only messages whose OSC path contains this text.
osc_log.pause: Pause or resume live capture. While paused the list stays frozen for inspection; traffic still flows.
palette.capture: Capture the selected channel's chosen processing into a new palette.
palette.channel_number: Channel number to capture the palette from.
palette.channel_type: Channel type to capture the palette from.
palette.delete: Delete this palette and unlink it from any snapshots.
palette.include: Include this processing block (EQ / dynamics) when capturing the palette.
palette.name: Name for the new palette.
palette.recapture: Overwrite this palette with the current state of its channel.
palette.rename: Rename this palette — press Enter to apply, Escape to cancel.
panlink.apply: Commit staged links. Aux send pans don't move until the input main pan next changes.
panlink.revert: Discard staged changes and resync with the live bindings.
recovery.load: Load this backup / autosave copy into the show.
recovery.load_invalid: This copy is corrupt and can't be loaded.
recovery.save_original: Write the recovered show back to the original file path.
scope.clear_changes: Discard the highlighted live changes — clears the dirty markers only; nothing is sent to the console.
scope.console_conflict: In console session scope, not safed for this channel
scope.mode_fade: Edit each parameter's fade time on recall.
scope.mode_pre_wait: Edit each parameter's pre-wait — the delay before it fires on recall.
scope.mode_scope: Edit which parameters each channel contributes to the scope.
scope.template_combo: Pick a saved scope template to load, update, or delete.
scope.template_load: Replace the current selection with the chosen scope template.
scope.template_save: Save the current selection as a new scope template named on the left.
setup.advanced: Cadence, diagnostics et autres préférences de l'application.
setup.console_ip: Adresse IP de la console S21.
setup.console_ip_warning: Console IP isn't on the selected NIC's network (first two octets differ — unreachable even with /16). Click to dismiss.
setup.console_port: Console port — daemon sends GP OSC here.
setup.coverage: Show which console parameters the daemon currently mirrors.
setup.ipad_console_port: Console iPad-protocol port — daemon sends here.
setup.ipad_ip: iPad device IP — leave blank to auto-detect from first inbound packet.
setup.ipad_listen_port: Local port the daemon listens on for iPad→daemon traffic.
setup.ipad_local_port: Local port the daemon listens on for iPad-protocol traffic.
setup.ipad_reply_port: Port on the iPad — daemon sends to it here.
setup.local_port: Local port the daemon listens on for GP OSC from the console.
setup.monitor_port: Local port for the Flutter monitor app — leave blank to disable.
setup.network: Local network interface the daemon binds to for OSC — pick the NIC on the console's network, or All interfaces.
setup.new_show: Start a new, empty show — clears the current snapshots, macros, gangs and palettes.
setup.open_show: Pick a show file and load it. Save As… to save to a new path.
setup.qlab_host: QLab host — usually 127.0.0.1 if QLab runs on this machine.
setup.qlab_port: QLab's OSC listen port — daemon sends cue-build commands here.
setup.save_show: Save to the path shown above. If empty, prompts for a location.
setup.save_show_as: Pick a new location and save there. Useful when the path field already points at a different file.
setup.trigger_port: Local port the daemon listens on for cue triggers from QLab.
shift.apply: Apply the row shift to every matching cue.
shift.delta: Amount to add to each matching row — negative shifts down; rows reaching 0 are cleared.
shift.from_row: Shift cues whose console snapshot row is at or above this number.
snapshot.auto_update: When recalling a snapshot, write any dirty parameters within the previous snapshot's scope back into it. Captures mid-show tweaks automatically.
snapshot.bulk_shift: Bulk-shift every cue's console snapshot when you've inserted or removed snapshots on the console.
snapshot.capture_now: Capture the current console state into a new snapshot, filtered by the scope above.
snapshot.console_follow_req: Requires Mode 2 or Mode 3 (iPad protocol) — the console snapshot list is only reachable via that protocol.
snapshot.edit_scope: Open the scope editor to choose which parameters this snapshot captures or recalls.
snapshot.picker: Choose which app snapshot this cue recalls (type to filter).
snapshot.re_recall: Re-recall this snapshot now to confirm nothing drifted
snapshot.recall: Recall the selected snapshot to the console.
snapshot.recall_no_scope_req: Only available for snapshots captured with 'Apply scope on recall' — ApplyOnSave snapshots already filtered at capture time, so there is nothing outside the saved scope to recall.
snapshot.recapture: Overwrite the selected snapshot with the current console state.
snapshot.scope_override: Recall this cue with a different scope than the snapshot's own.
snapshot.scope_override_template: Scope template to apply when recalling this cue.
snapshot.undo: Undo the last snapshot recall, restoring the previous values.
streamdeck.add_step: Add the chosen macro as a step on the selected button.
streamdeck.button_macro: Macro to add as the next step for the selected button.
streamdeck.close: Close Stream Deck setup and go back to the macro step editor.
streamdeck.device: Pick the Stream Deck to control, or a template to edit a button map offline.
streamdeck.disable: Disable the Stream Deck integration. Disconnects the device but preserves your button maps.
streamdeck.enable: Enable the Stream Deck integration. Auto-connects to the previously-selected device if it's plugged in; otherwise open Setup… to pick one.
streamdeck.open_panel: Open the Stream Deck panel — device selection, button grid, per-button macro sequences.
ui_mode.full: Full mode: every tab is shown — Snapshots, Macros, Gangs, Pan Link, Monitor, Palettes.
ui_mode.live_music: Live Music mode: hides Snapshots and the cue transport — for bands working without a cue list.
ui_mode.theatre: Theatre mode: cue-driven workflow; hides the Monitor tab.
